Part of [C: Cardiovascular system](../).

**Mechanistic extrapolation.**
PBPK dominates here, predicting OATP1B1 transporter-mediated statin interactions and SLCO1B1 genotype effects on exposure; cardiorenal QSP models extrapolate blood-pressure and renal responses for antihypertensives [@yoshikadoQuantitativeAnalysesHepatic2016; @jameiMechanisticFrameworkVitro2014].
